name: core_totem_one_mon_party
_note: Regression: starting a Totem battle (a double, player battler 2 permanently inactive) with a one-Pokemon party asserted in Party_GetPokemonBySlotIndex (party.c): the doubles setup left party slot 1 in the inactive player slot and BattleMain_InitTerrains fetched it. The inactive slot now carries the MAX_PARTY_SIZE sentinel from setup, and party-order/terrain init skip sentinel slots. The lone Chimchar must reach the Mamoswine Totem battle, lose, black out, and return to the field.
